production_reducer.note: TST-0001 authors command-center/completion_predicate.py as the 12-condition production reducer the harness binds. platform/lib/completion_predicate.py uses SATISFIED/COMPLETE and is a different API. ready_units.artifact_delivered is a coarser boolean and is not this reducer.

extensions.question: Does any condition of the 12 lack a distinguishable failing-condition-id in the production reducer?

negative_controls.description: A reducer stubbed to return True always must FAIL this harness.

residual_unknowns.claim: fail-C02 also makes C03/C04/C05 false because a missing artifact cannot be sized, parsed, or sentinel-checked; first failing id remains C02, so the production reducer still emits a distinguishable C02 id.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: TST-0002 isolation corpus records any condition pair that cannot be separated as a contract defect.

retry.policy: two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)

reviewer.notes: Probe2 is the fresh-context adversarial check: byte-identity of verdict objects against the oracle, plus the always-true negative control. Catalog author vendor is anthropic; this reviewer is openai.
